rv.q: For all of its humorous moments, this play ends up ripping your heart out through your eyes and ears.
This play is beautiful and devastating and moving and surprising all in 95 minutes with no intermission.
This wonderful company, dedicated to women's stories and groundbreaking theater through a female lens, is presenting the World Premiere of "Motherhouse" written by Tuckie White.
The two tones felt more at odds with each other than they did complimentary.

cn.t: White's family drama delivers a devastating exploration of grief and buried secrets that's achingly funny and tragic, leaving audiences shaken despite some finding the complications don't fully land.
